releaseNotes: PRVN Music v0.0.9 (Build 12): Ultimate Playback & Synchronization Overhaul. Restored high-performance Media3 DefaultAudioSink for zero-stutter continuous streaming; eliminated native DAC ring-buffer stalls and A/V clock drift; fixed Play Together room JSON parsing for peer tracks and shared queues; added automatic join retries and safe drift thresholds so both normal playback and Listen Together play smooth, synchronized audio without stuttering.
